name: React to discussion mentions
description: Runs an agent in the discussion whenever it is @-mentioned there.

de.name: Auf Diskussions-Erwähnungen reagieren
de.description: Startet einen Agenten in der Diskussion, sobald er dort @-erwähnt wird.

fr.name: Réagir aux mentions en discussion
fr.description: Lance un agent dans la discussion dès qu'il y est mentionné avec @.

config.description: Writes by the automation engine itself (routing nudges, summaries) are inert by design — only human- and agent-authored mentions trigger runs. This is the discussion-pack analog of the task-pack workflow-actor guard.
Human mentions are plain notifications (handled by the collab layer). An agent can never trigger itself.

steps.name: Run the mentioned agent in the discussion

parameters.instructions: You were @-mentioned in this project discussion. Read it and post a helpful reply in your area of responsibility. If it is outside your remit, say so briefly and @-mention the teammate who should weigh in. If you cannot help, say so precisely.
